scope: Node full configuration initialization and update; retirement of three noninteractive Python Kconfig entrypoints
comparison: Exact complete config bytes match Python, repeated loading is idempotent, full autoconf output stays identical
backupChecks: Previous bytes preserved as .old on change
No-op preserves output mtime and previous .old
Existing and dangling config symlinks preserved
Parse failure leaves config and backup untouched

benchmark.scope: New Node process, TypeScript loading, full Kconfig parse, config file read, resolution and atomic output write. Warm filesystem cache and, unless disabled, warmed Node compile cache. Build-time path only.

withoutCompileCache.scope: New Node process, TypeScript loading, full Kconfig parse, config file read, resolution and atomic output write. Warm filesystem cache and, unless disabled, warmed Node compile cache. Build-time path only.

pythonBaseline.scope: New Python process through existing olddefconfig.py, complete parse/load/resolve/write; warm filesystem cache; sequential same-machine baseline

firmwareBuild.initialState: No KCONFIG_CONFIG file and empty output directory

limitations: Interactive menuconfig remains Python with bundled Kconfiglib
Other project Python/runtime/printing entrypoints are not retired
Uncached process startup is slower than Python; build-time work only
No hardware flash, actual printer acceptance, or closure of runtime/precision diagnostics
